information: EGYPT OPEN 2025 The Egypt open 2025 will be held at the Eastern Company Club in Giza on Saturday, September 13. Registration is open until September 10, and all fees must be paid before the competition using one of the methods shown. You can participate in one or more events without restrictions, with the same fees. After registering on the official website, registration is suspended until the fees are paid. After payment, participation will be confirmed by the organizing team.
